updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.8.1
- Additional updates since last Beta notes:
  - OKB Out Page commands and Auto Browse fixes, No longer needs Auto Browse to issue Page commands Auto browse full rework.
  - OKB Out refined AWACS tab now includes SAM radars that are radiating and active, Also groups AIR, SAM and EWR with sorting by range.(Still requires AWACS to be on task)
  - OKB Out new AID (Aircraft Interface Device) connection. Controls STORES and also the new FUEL data Block with live feed fuel metrics
 - New AH-64D George pilot commands and backend workflow.
 - New TX-Link implementation, combined module case reworked from scratch.
 - Added Jester Wheel visibiity external context commands that control Wheel visibity on/off can be added to voice, button or key presses in Voice attack to manually turn wheel visibilty on and off.
 - Add collapsed run handling of numeric F-14 commands like Radio Frequence, Laser Code and Link Tune (requires updates to Voice Attack profile commands). 
 - Minor change to Hide Menus to ensure communicator is avaiable on modueles when hidden. 
 - Fix TX Link short press and ICS gating 
- Fix potential loss of Function Keys due to menuvisible()
 - OKB Speed ALT and DIST metric units now availble as toggle on NAVLOG headings.
 - TACAN tune Command F-14 AIRIO logic hardening 
 - WIP OKB out EFB Moving Map history track layer
 - Fix numerous A-64 Pilot command bugs./n - Remove Old logging
 -Fix track History render OKB Out/n - Update F-14 AIRO EGI navigation commands and add ne resolver pass to avoid conditional waypoints.
